scenarios.description: Qualify raw Speech Task terminal delivery and independently selected transcription output through the public Gateway.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_SPEECH_TASK_INPUT mode complete, an installation target and public Gateway profile, private normal OAuth token file, an existing authorized recording, independent source/text/model/policy expectations and a new private JSONL receipt. Creates one real CUDA transcription Task and reads its outputs. Requires installed NVIDIA CUDA readiness. Uses shared remote Task and actual-handle cleanup; no process restart or installed recovery qualification.

scenarios.description: Qualify raw Speech Task cancellation delivery after an observed unfinished real recording.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_SPEECH_TASK_INPUT mode cancel, normal private OAuth token-file inputs and a selected genuine governed recording that remains unfinished at its current Task read. Persists cancellation intent, invokes official cancellation and requires exact-ID delivered/current Cancelled without successful output. Early completion fails qualification without replay. Creates real CUDA work; uses shared Task/SDK cleanup and does not restart processes or qualify recovery.

scenarios.description: Qualify one genuinely Working Speech Task across an observed selected server-container crash and replacement.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_SPEECH_TASK_INPUT mode recover, an explicit recovery object containing a CrashTarget and replacementTimeoutSeconds1..300, normal private OAuth inputs, retained authorized source/output authority, installed CUDA, and a genuine recording that stays Working before and after process replacement. The target must select the maintained Helm speech-mcp Rust server container/process and component role (custom container-role renaming is unsupported), with single-replica ownership and unchanged same-Pod Deployment/ReplicaSet/image identity. An authorized external operator signals that selected process only after the private journal records recovery.armed=true. The harness observes the crash and never sends a signal or repeats Task creation. Early completion fails qualification. Requires delivered/current same-ID completion, transcription/provenance and current-resource snapshot agreement; owns original SDK/watch cleanup. No inference continuity or post-mutation resource-delivery claim.
